scope_limit: Measures agreement with Valhalla's free-flow model. Does NOT measure real-world drive time.

provenance.reproducibility_note: The Valhalla public instance does not expose its graph build version through /isochrone, /route or /locate, so isochrone geometry, IoU and route times cannot be re-derived from this repository alone at a later date -- only re-measured against whatever graph is live then. Raw responses are cached under reports/accuracy/.request_cache/, which is gitignored for size (~490 MB). POI-level rates ARE fully recomputable from the committed poi_universe.json.

snap_sensitivity_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic added during implementation. It measures the stability of the reference geometry and takes no part in the preregistered pass/fail rule.

query_envelope.note: POI-independent by construction; the exploratory target-FI candidate took no part in defining it

dedup_rules.osm_internal: same name within 150 m, per category
dedup_rules.cross_source: merge_overture.same_place: exact name <300 m, name containment <150 m, or equal house-number + first street word

geometry.note: Definitional, not evidence: the true isochrone is the reference geometry being compared with itself. Its merit is only that it adds no approximation on top of the model's; it is NOT real-world accuracy.

guardrail_G1_equal_area_identity.note: These two areas are identically equal by construction for an equal-area candidate -- ONE number, not two independent findings. Used only to detect projection/polygon-algebra bugs.

exclusion_reasons: POI-dependent: violates the POI-independence admission rule
tuned on the same POIs it is then scored against
